content.value_statement: UniFi teams need a clear view of active deployments, configuration changes, and progress. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code collect status and guide deployment reviews.
actual_capabilities: List active deployments across UniFi sites.
Retrieve detailed information for a specific deployment.
Monitor deployment status, progress, and health.
Track deployment configuration and change history.
Analyze deployment metrics for operational review.
Generate deployment status and history reports.
limitations: It depends on available deployment data and tool permissions.
It does not create, approve, or roll back deployments.
It cannot guarantee real-time status if source data is stale.
It does not replace production change control procedures.

use_cases.title: Monitor Active Rollouts
use_cases.description: Review current UniFi deployments, progress, and health before an operations check-in.

use_cases.title: Plan Maintenance Windows
use_cases.description: Understand current deployment load before scheduling infrastructure updates across sites.

use_cases.title: Document Change History
use_cases.description: Summarize deployment changes, status, and configuration details for audit records.

prompt_templates.title: Show Current Deployments
prompt_templates.prompt: Show all active UniFi deployments and summarize current status, progress, and affected sites.

prompt_templates.title: Review One Deployment
prompt_templates.prompt: Get details for the selected deployment and explain its status, configuration, health, and next expected step.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Change Summary
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a deployment report that lists recent changes, current progress, health concerns, and items needing follow-up.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Rollout Risk
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare active deployments, identify stalled or failed work, assess operational impact, and prepare handoff notes with rollback considerations.

output: A concise list of active deployments grouped by site.
Status, progress, health, and configuration summary for each deployment.
A short note on deployments that need attention.

output_examples.input: Are any deployments stalled or failed?
output: A focused status review that highlights stalled, failed, or delayed deployments.
Likely impact areas and recommended operational follow-up.
A report-ready summary for the deployment owner.

output_examples.input: Prepare a change history report for current rollouts.
output: A deployment change summary with affected sites and configuration notes.
Progress and health context for each active change.
A closing list of open questions for the change record.

best_practices: Review deployment status before and after each maintenance window.
Document configuration changes and affected sites during every rollout.
Confirm rollback plans before coordinating multi-site deployments.
anti_patterns: Do not use stale deployment data for production decisions.
Do not skip normal approval steps because a status report looks healthy.
Do not treat monitoring output as a replacement for deployment logs.

faq.question: What does this skill help me manage?
faq.answer: It helps track UniFi deployment status, progress, configuration, health, and reporting.

faq.question: Can it start or stop deployments?
faq.answer: No. The documented capability focuses on listing deployments and reviewing deployment details.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it support troubleshooting?
faq.answer: Yes. It can help identify problematic deployments and summarize details for diagnostics.

faq.question: Can it generate reports?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill describes deployment status, history, metrics, and change reporting.

faq.question: What data quality should I expect?
faq.answer: Results depend on the deployment tools, permissions, and freshness of the available UniFi data.
